title: A bigger ideal emitter
hook: Change surface area and predict radiated power.
misconception: radiated power stays fixed when surface area doubles.
objective: Apply P = σAT⁴ to compare radiated power when surface area changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With an ideal blackbody at fixed absolute temperature, P = σAT⁴. When surface area doubles, radiated power becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model P = σAT⁴; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider an ideal blackbody at fixed absolute temperature, with a nonzero initial result. If surface area triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on radiated power?
recall.why: Apply P = σAT⁴ under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
